create_dataloader: create a DataLoader instance that loads JSON data and samples training validation examples by distribution
call_next_batch: call next_batch on a DataLoader to get a batch of description tree pairs for training or evaluation
call_update_buffer: call update_buffer on a DataLoader to replace random buffer entries with hard examples from mistakes
call_reset_valid: call reset_valid on a DataLoader to reset the validation set index counters to their initial state
call_make_batch: call make_batch to convert description action tree pairs into padded PyTorch tensors for model input
